7_image_cv_preprocessing_opencv_c_ext.note: Already executed in native C/C++ SIMD via OpenCV (`cv2`) and Pillow (`libjpeg-turbo`/`zlib`).

gate_d_criteria_evaluation.justification: Across 118 benchmark problems (`Dev72` + `HeldOut46`), the entire Python deterministic pipeline (`Lexer -> Grammar Parser -> Bridge v2 -> Source Gate -> Planner /26 -> Exact Kernel /24`) executes in ~3.5 ms median (~14.5 ms including full `Adapter /4` `Scene3D` + construction continuity steps), and warm parser cache hits take ~0.06 ms. Image preprocessing already runs in native C++ via OpenCV (`cv2`). Introducing a Rust/PyO3 build toolchain would add cross-platform compilation complexity for < 2 ms wall-clock gain. Therefore, per Section 4.1–4.3, the evidence-backed engineering decision is `NO_RUST_NEEDED`.
